verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story. mParticle documents GDPR/CCPA compliance tooling [mparticle-docs-10], and its Data Privacy Controls cover consent and opt-out forwarding rules [mparticle-docs-x3], which suggests privacy-obligation handling. Nothing in the pack explicitly describes data retention settings or user data deletion or erasure workflows. Missing for 10: documented data retention period configuration, explicit deletion/erasure request APIs or workflows, programmatic or agent-accessible control of these, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
